name: smwmusic-super-castlevania-iv-cellar
title: Super Castlevania IV - Cellar
description:
This track is relatively tense/chilling background music. It has an ostinato in the drum parts throughout and sustained stings as the melody periodically. This would work well in forest/ghost levels or other similar themes.

Featured in the secret exit of the level "Thalassophobia" in Grand Poo World 2
